pitchMm.description: Stroke and row spacing in millimetres; omit for the CAM default (1 mm).

seed.description: The stipple’s jitter and direction seed; the same seed gives the same pattern. Omit for 1.

strokeMm.description: A stipple stroke’s length in millimetres; omit for the CAM default (1 mm). Ignored by scallop.

through.description: Cut through the blank to the sacrificial board; the floor is the breakthrough rule and depth is then only the checked pocket depth.

vCarveDepth.description: A V-carved region's depth: 'plane' (absent — the constant floor at the colour plane) or 'variable' (the medial-axis depth map, cut as a ladder of level sets).

width.description: Bounding-box width of the outline in millimetres.

kind.description: Held in the vise.

vise.description: The vise jaw measurements the job was set up with.

jawStartY.description: Work-coordinate Y where the jaws begin, in millimetres.

measuredAt.description: When the jaws were measured; omitted for a default or saved set.

proudSource.description: Where the proud number came from: 'seat' (re-derived; the default when absent) or 'stated' (typed by a person).

seat.description: What the blank's underside rests on: the soft jaws' ledge or the body floor.

source.description: Where these jaw numbers came from: a default, a saved setup, or a measurement.

stockProud.description: How far the stock stands proud of the jaws, in millimetres.

uncertainty.description: Measurement uncertainty in millimetres; 0 for values taken as exact.

kind.description: Held in the rotary module's four-jaw self-centring chuck.

rotary.description: The chuck facts the job was set up with.

gripDiameter.description: The diameter the jaws close on, in millimetres, or null when the chuck does not state it.

jawMode.description: Which jaws are fitted, by Makera's rule by diameter: 'standard' under ⌀20 mm, 'reverse-inner' from ⌀20 to ⌀35, 'reverse-outer' over ⌀35. A legacy 'reverse' reads as 'reverse-inner'.

neck.description: The neck to leave the part on for sawing off, when one is wanted.

diameter.description: The diameter the part is held on, in millimetres.

end.description: The end of the free span the neck is cut at: 'chuck' or 'tailstock'.

length.description: How long the neck runs along the stock, in millimetres.

source.description: The page these chuck facts come from.

stickout.description: How far the rod stands out of the chuck jaws along X, in millimetres.

tailstock.description: Whether the tailstock supports the free end of the rod.

kind.description: Held on the bed under tape.

tape.description: The tape the job was set up with.

anchor.description: The anchor the bracket is pinned at.

edges.description: Which arms the blank touches: the corner, both of them.

kind.description: What the fence is: the bracket of the Makera kit.

obstacles.description: Boxes the mount cannot know, as the bracket hold states them.

id.description: A stable id for the box, so a finding can name it.

label.description: The box in landmark words — "the counterbored hole, 8 mm in from the left edge".

max.description: The box’s high corner in the work frame, mm.

min.description: The box’s low corner in the work frame: X 0..length, Y 0..width, Z0 on the stock’s top, mm.

placement.description: As the bracket hold's placement: absent = 'anchored'.

variant.description: The bracket fitted, as its fixture record names it — 'thin' is the Makera kit's L-bracket.

fence.description: The bracket as a fence: what LOCATES the taped blank (the tape holds it). Absent or null = no fence; the blank is squared to the bed's front edge. With a fence, where is null and squareTo is 'fence'.

inset.description: How far in from every edge the tape strips stop, in millimetres.

source.description: Where these tape numbers came from: a default, a saved setup, or a measurement.

squareTo.description: What the tape keeps square: the bed's front edge, or the bracket's fence when one is stated. The program is never rotated.

thickness.description: The tape's thickness under the stock, in millimetres.

x.description: Machine X of the stock's expected front-left corner, in millimetres.

y.description: Machine Y of the stock's expected front-left corner, in millimetres.

where.description: Where on the surface the stock is expected, in machine X/Y, or null for the middle of the surface.

width.description: The tape roll width in millimetres.

bracket.description: The bracket and the clamp places the job was set up with.

anchor.description: The anchor the bracket is pinned at; Makera's origin is relative to Anchor 1.

clamps.description: The clamp places the job was set up with, on the free edges. One to four; ZERO only when the board under the blank is taped (the vendor tray’s side-2 hold — the bracket is then only the fence).

at.description: The clamp's centre along its edge, in millimetres from the edge's left end (back edge) or front end (right edge).

edge.description: The free edge the clamp holds: 'back' or 'right'. The bracket holds the front and the left.

kind.description: How the clamp holds: 'top' presses on the stock from above; 'side' pushes it from outside the blank's edge, its top below the stock top. Absent means 'top', so a stored job is unchanged.

obstacles.description: Boxes the mount cannot know and the program must not sweep through — holes already in the blank, screwed down — in the work frame. Absent means none.

id.description: A stable id for the box, so a finding can name it.

label.description: The box in landmark words — "the counterbored hole, 8 mm in from the left edge".

max.description: The box’s high corner in the work frame, mm.

min.description: The box’s low corner in the work frame: X 0..length, Y 0..width, Z0 on the stock’s top, mm.

placement.description: How the bracket is bolted down. Absent = 'anchored': on the table's pins at the anchor, and the anchor datum is the origin. 'placed': screwed to the MDF wasteboard where the operator put it — no anchor datum; the origin and rotation are probed from the blank.

source.description: Where these bracket numbers came from: a default, a saved setup, or a measurement.

variant.description: The bracket fitted, as its fixture record names it — 'thin' is the Makera kit's L-bracket.

kind.description: Held on the bed pushed into the bracket's corner and clamped.

z0CarriedFrom.description: Z0 = the earlier setup's Z0 − this thickness; the run sheet says the sawn underside is never touched.

thicknessMm.description: The part's measured thickness from the earlier setup, mm.
